description: Customisable settings for the signage app

name.description: Application name for the PlaceOS API client. If the URL pathname is empty, the app also uses this name to make the settings metadata key

short_name.description: Prefix for console log messages. The app also uses it as the API client application name if `name` is not set

default_animation_time.description: Duration in milliseconds of the media player's transition animation between playlist items. Defaults to `1000`. If the value is `0` or not set, the player uses `3000`

templates_enabled.description: Whether template selection is available during signage bootstrap. Defaults to `true`.
